note: Add a model by copying an entry. Six architecture parameters drive the whole calculation. See CONTRIBUTING.md. models[0] is the product default.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
models.notes: Product default. Yardstick for appliance SKUs (Spark / RTX PRO). Weights ~22 GB NVFP4 → 0.63 bytes/param. KV/token from the published single-Spark recipe: 62.08 GiB KV for 5,359,388 tokens → 11.58 KB/token. specTokens=2.0 reflects native MTP in that stack (acceptance varies; profiles carry measured throughput). Prefer NVFP4 on Blackwell; FP8 is a supported fallback.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
models.license: Verify weight licence for commercial use
models.notes: Weights 284B total / 13B active per OpenRouter. KV/token calibrated against the 2x DGX Spark recipe (1,548,597 token pool at util 0.78) with NVFP4 KV (kv_cache_dtype=nvfp4_ds_mla). RESOLVED vs the FP8 community figure: that ~10.6 KB/token measurement used FP8 KV on a different checkpoint and belongs only on deepseek-v4-flash-0731-fp8 — not a second sample of this NVFP4-KV path. Boot-to-boot KV pool still swings ~11%; treat 27.77 as the recipe baseline.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (official FP8)
models.license: Verify weight licence for commercial use
models.notes: Back-derived from a community run: 167 GB measured weights / 284B = 0.588 bytes per parameter, so not pure FP8. KV/token from a 988K pool in 13.5 GB free with FP8 KV. Not comparable to the NVFP4-KV Spark recipe — different cache dtype and checkpoint. Treat as unverified until a pinned first-party soak exists.

models.name: Laguna S 2.1
sources: Operator run on 1x DGX Station GB300, July 2026
models.notes: KV/token derived from a measured run: 2,767,665 resident tokens in ~199 GB free. Prefill/decode ratio from the same run (43,026 vs 652 tok/s).

models.name: Qwen3.5 397B-A17B
models.notes: Flagship Qwen3.5 MoE (512 experts, 10 routed + 1 shared). NVFP4 is NVIDIA's recommended Blackwell deploy precision; minimum validated footprint is 4× B200/B300/GB200/GB300. KV/token derived for FP8 KV on the ~15 full-attention blocks in the 3×GDN→1×GQA layout (15 × 2 × 2 × 256 × 1 B ≈ 15 KB/token); GDN state is fixed-size overhead. Throughput on b300-4x is deploy-guide validated for fit, not a published tok/s table — see profile.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b
models.quantLabel: MXFP4/NVFP4 weights + FP8 KV (FP8 weights on Hopper)
models.notes: Yardstick for datacenter SKUs. Official checkpoint ~60.8 GiB for 116.8B params → 0.52 bytes/param (MXFP4 MoE). KV/token derived for FP8 KV on the 18 full-attention layers only: 18 × 2 × 8 × 64 × 1 B = 18 KB/token; 18 sliding-window layers are a fixed buffer (folded into overhead), not per-token growth. Default NVFP4/MXFP4 on Blackwell; engine falls back to FP8 on Hopper (H200). TRT-LLM tables are offline max-throughput — see Benchmarks.

models.name: Generic 70B dense (template)
models.license: Depends on the model you substitute
models.notes: Starting point for a small-tier package. On a dense model total and active parameters are the same number, which is why it decodes far slower than a MoE of the same footprint.
